column1: # The bitmap pictures of UI-9a and what each becomes (docs/specs/ui-refresh-plan.md sections 4.3 and 4.5; docs/port-notes/UI-9a.md).
# tools/Convert-PictureUses.ps1 reads this file. One row per purpose (section 4.3): "Resources:<name>" covers every window that shows that
# Properties.Resources picture; "<resx file>:<entry>" is one window's own .resx picture; "*" matches anything (PowerShell -like).
# target: EnumIcons.<member> (OpenPmsDental.UI.EnumIcons, its manifest row in icons/manifest.json), DentalIcon.<member>, keep (stays a
# picture; the note says why, section 4.5) or UI-9b (an ImageList, converted by package UI-9b).
# size (optional): the bitmap's size when it is not the picture's; the width stays (where a button's text starts).
